---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Abhineeth Duddela"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

\`\`\`{r}
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
\`\`\`

\`\`\`{r}
storms |>
  distinct(year, name) |>
  count(year) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Named Storms per Year", x = "Year", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
\`\`\`
